verdict.rationale: Secureframe embeds its Comply AI in specific workflows. It automates risk assessments (scores, treatment, justifications), drafts and revises policies, extracts answers from vendor documents, generates SSPs/POA&Ms, and produces infrastructure-as-code remediation fixes. These are task-specific AI features, not a general built-in assistant to which a user can delegate arbitrary tasks. The MCP server exposes data to external agents and is not an in-product assistant, so it is not credited here. Missing for 10: a general-purpose in-app conversational or agentic assistant that accepts delegated tasks across the platform, documentation of how delegation works, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
